name: Starry Majestic Meteor
effects:
Master Mode, Instant ATB 1 & Diffusion Barrier 1 to user
Master Mode: Cap Break Level 4, Hero Boost +25%, Zero SB Cost 1 & Instant SB/LB Cast 1; If enemy gains DEF/RES/MND buff, chases with DEF/RES/MND -50% for 8 seconds to all targets (max 1 chase)
Interval Chase: 10 single-target Fire/NE, Ice/NE, Wind/NE or Earth/NE hybrid attacks under En-Fire, En-Ice, En-Wind or En-Earth, Hero Boost +30/35/40/45/50% to user after 1/2/3/4/5 chases (max 5 chases)
Master Chase: Single-target Fire/Ice/Wind/Earth/NE piercing hybrid attack at True Cap Break Level 1, removes Master Mode
